properties.title: Agent turns per minute
properties.query: SOURCE 'aws/spans' | filter name = 'wealth_agent.turn' | stats count() as turns by bin(1m)

properties.title: Turn latency p50 / p95 (seconds)
properties.query: SOURCE 'aws/spans' | filter name = 'wealth_agent.turn' | stats pct(durationNano/1000000000, 50) as p50, pct(durationNano/1000000000, 95) as p95 by bin(5m)

properties.title: Token usage (model calls, where reported)
properties.query: SOURCE 'aws/spans' | filter name = 'chat' | stats sum(attributes.`gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`) as input_tokens, sum(attributes.`gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`) as output_tokens by bin(5m)

properties.title: Turns by compliance status
properties.query: SOURCE 'aws/spans' | filter name = 'wealth_agent.turn' | stats count() as turns by attributes.compliance_status

properties.title: Failed guardrail rules (last turns)
properties.query: SOURCE 'aws/spans' | filter name = 'wealth_agent.turn' and attributes.compliance_status = 'fail' | fields @timestamp, attributes.`session.id` as session, attributes.compliance_failed_rules as failed_rules, traceId | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50
